source.where: games.fun research/studio-v2/evals/cases/T4.json (frozen 2026-10-08): the creator's roguelike prompt and their three images, verbatim

prompt: Make a high quality rogue like multiplayer game with very smooth assets. The game should have several levels you have to clear all monsters in and then a final boss level. Take inspiration from games like Lost Castle and Rampage Knights. The assets should look very close to the attached images

ledger.means: A run: it starts fresh, gets harder as it goes, and ends won or lost
Friends play the same run together

ledger.words: several levels you have to clear all monsters in
ledger.means: Several levels: each is cleared of every monster, then the way to the next opens
The last level is a boss fight: one big enemy with its own health bar and attacks it signals before they land

ledger.words: games like Lost Castle and Rampage Knights
ledger.means: As in the named games: players fight up close with weapons they swing, and the hits read (a flash, a flinch, a health bar)

ledger.words: games like Lost Castle and Rampage Knights
ledger.means: As in the named games: weapons or items picked up during the run change how a player fights
More than one kind of monster, and the boss is bigger than they are

ledger.words: look very close to the attached images
ledger.means: Floating mossy islands over a void, glowing violet and green crystals and a portal, a high three-quarter camera, small chunky characters
Finished models, not stand-ins, that keep their shape when they move

multiplayer.bar: Two players in one game, in sync: each screen shows the other player as a character where they really are, in the same round or run, and each sees their own score as their own.

control.text: The game includes a working chess board
